repo.name: scheduling-kit
repo.description: Backend-agnostic, headless scheduling library with pluggable adapters, payment processors, and Svelte UI; delivered through Bzlmod from the Bazel //:pkg artifact.

sbom.notes: scheduling-kit enrollment dimensions (TIN-2110 pilot): forge scope = tinyland-inc; operator overlay = tinyland-infra; execution pool = tinyland-nix (in-cluster ARC); substrate mode = shared-cache-backed (cache-first, TIN-1997 Option D). The Bazel cache endpoint is injected at runtime by the in-cluster nix-setup (never baked); enrollment is self-verified via scripts/cache-attachment-contract.sh --strict. Cache-first only: no remote executor / REAPI lane is wired.
